en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing four African men standing side by side on a dirt road in a village lined with thatched huts and woven fences. They wear feathered headdresses, patterned cloths wrapped around their waists, and carry rifles and hunting trophies. The scene is ethnographic in character. Printed captions appear at the top: on the left, the word "Loanda" and on the right, "Caçadores de Cabiri - No. 1."
